versions.subject: Raspberry Robin Related Rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\msiexec.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'msiexec.exe'
selection_cli:
    # Note that there is no space before and after the arguments because it's possible to write a commandline as such
    # Example: msiexec -q/i [MSI Package]
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/i'
        - '-i'
        - '/package'
        - '-package'
        - '/a'
        - '-a'
        - '/j'
        - '-j'
selection_quiet:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '/q'
        - '-q'
selection_remote:
    - 'http'
    - '\\\\'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\msiexec.exe" OR OriginalFileName="msiexec.exe" CommandLine IN ("*/i*", "*-i*", "*/package*", "*-package*", "*/a*", "*-a*", "*/j*", "*-j*") CommandLine IN ("*/q*", "*-q*") "http" OR "\\\\"
